items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Do you remember in St. Louis any of the places like Tom Turpin and his brother Charlie ran the place Jazzland?

ctx.x: There would be maybe a week in St. Louis and go maybe a week in Devonport Highway and up to St. Paul, Minnesota and work back and further down the river and then all the way back to New Orleans. And I didn't like living on the boat. The first two years we were up there, we were in New Orleans, the season, winter season. And we were in St. Louis, the summer season. See, and we had rooms in town. We'd knock off at night, go to our rooms or go to a restaurant, anywhere we had to go. Well, when they started making…
Yeah, every night sometimes. Yeah. Do you remember in St. Louis any of the places like Tom Turpin and his brother Charlie ran the place Jazzland?
Yeah, we used to go to the Jazzland.
